name: QueryInterface
source: 0x4f10c0: ids 1, 0xe4fda3d4, 0xec2391bf give this, 0x8db5bf48 the container face (+4), 0x456b8f1d the persist face (+8); AddRef on success.

name: AddRef
source: Shared increment of the count at +0xc (0x15e520).

name: Release
source: 0x4f1660: counts above one are decremented, otherwise the object destroys itself (no virtual destructor).

name: Write
source: 0x4f1950: version 1, entry count, then every entry's id and the entry saved under a key derived from the table's group.

name: Read
source: 0x4f1130: version, count, then every id's data object is looked up through the persist system and added when the id is new.

name: GetGZCLSID
source: 0x4f0fc0 returns 0x2c310f46.

name: Clear
source: 0x4f1920: erases every entry (releasing the data objects), clears the modified flag; returns 1.

name: Save
source: 0x4f1860: asks the persist system for the table's segment, saves the table into it and flushes it; clears the modified flag on success.

name: Set
source: 0x4f0b80: marks the table modified; replaces the data object of an existing id (returns 1) or adds the id (returns 0).

name: Remove
source: 0x4f16c0: removes an id (marking the table modified) and releases its data object; returns whether it existed.

name: IsModified
source: 0x46a260 (folded) reads the byte at +0x20.

name: SetModified
source: 0x4f10b0 sets the byte at +0x20.

name: Get
source: 0x4f1000: the data object of an id, not counted for the caller, null when the id is not in the table.

name: Count
source: 0x15f390 (folded) reads the entry count at +0x28.

name: FirstId
source: 0x4f0fe0: the smallest id, 0xffffffff for an empty table.

name: NextId
source: 0x4f1050: the next larger id, 0xffffffff when the id is the last one or not present.

name: CreateData
source: 0x4f0ea0: a new genetic data object (type 0xebfee33f) from the cached resource manager, not counted for the caller; null without a manager.

name: LoadOrCreate
source: 0x4f0d00: finds (or creates) the data resource for an id in the resource manager and stores it in the table; returns it uncounted.

name: GetRefCount
source: 0x145770 (folded) reads the count at +0xc.

name: ReadFromHolder
source: 0x4f1760: asks the holder for its reader (0x051b11bd) and calls Read with it.

name: WriteToHolder
source: 0x4f17e0: asks the holder for its writer (0xc51b11cb) and calls Write with it.

name: GetPersistResource
source: 0x3a4f40 (folded) returns this+8, null for null.

name: QueryInterface
source: 0x4f1126 thunk for the persist face.

name: Release
source: 0x4f16b7 thunk for the persist face.

name: GetKey
source: 0x1ebbd0 (folded) copies the 16-byte resource key at +8 of the face to out and returns out.

name: SetKey
source: 0x1eec50 (folded) copies 16 bytes from key to +8 of the face; returns 1.

name: GetSint32
source: Read: version, entry count and every id come from slot 9 with an output pointer.

name: SetSint32
source: Write: version, entry count and every id go through slot 9.

name: SetMetadata
source: Write: a freshly built UtilObjectB for version 1 is handed over (the same as cTSTreeProperties::Write).

name: QueryInterface
source: ExportTo/ImportFrom ask the container for the id source 0x0db5c0c2.

name: Release
source: Released by nobody here: only queried.

name: GetInterface
source: ExportTo/ImportFrom ask it for 0x656b8f0c, the DB segment the table is saved into.

name: GetGroup
source: ExportTo/ImportFrom use it as the group word of the table's resource key.

name: Release
source: Released after ExportTo/ImportFrom.

name: GetIds
source: Fills an allocator-service vector of 32-bit ids (begin, end, capacity).

name: MapId
source: ImportFrom: the id to store the copied data under; failure skips the id and clears the result.

name: QueryInterface
source: Write asks each data object for the persist resource face 0x456b8f1d.

name: AddRef
source: Counted by the table's entries.

name: Release
source: Released by the table's entries.

name: SetProperty
source: ExportTo/ImportFrom copy every (name, value) property of a data object into a new one.

name: GetFirstProperty
source: Starts the property enumeration: fills name and value.

name: GetNextProperty
source: Continues it after the given name.

name: Release
source: Released after Save.

name: Flush
source: Save calls it after saving the table into the segment.

name: QueryInterface
source: ReadFromHolder / WriteToHolder ask for the reader 0x051b11bd / writer 0xc51b11cb.

name: GetResource
source: Read and ExportTo/ImportFrom: finds the resource of a key and hands out an interface (the persist system 0x10faf6c; same slot as cITSPersistSystem 5).

name: SaveResource
source: Write passes (resource, 0); Save and ExportTo pass the DB segment.

name: FindSegment
source: Save: finds the DB segment (id 0x656b8f0c) that holds a resource key.

name: GetResource
source: LoadOrCreate: finds the cached resource of a key (cached manager 0x20deb5).

name: CreateResource
source: CreateData / LoadOrCreate: creates an empty resource of a type (0xebfee33f for the data objects).
